task: FAL-282 (slice D of the FAL-271 art audit)
method: Same as slice A (walk-163-generation.json): one shipped frame is the anchor, the other five are qwen21_edit "change only its legs and feet/boots" edits of it, the two down frames get a CPU swing of the shawl, tail feathers or tail. New in slice D: deshadow.py clears the soft ground shadow the edit paints under the feet; finish_walk.py --balance 1 nudges frames 2-6 by at most 1 px so the whole-figure centre stays within 2 px; the sources are packed with pack_source.py --grid and built with "register": "grid", because the build's usual centring (upper 60 % of the figure) follows the swinging fox tail and slid the head 3-4 px. Old sources raven-walk.png and fox-walk.png are kept and marked skip.
anchors: raven-girl uses shipped frame 3: shipped frame 1's shawl and head differ from the other five frames (FAL-271 audit). The others keep shipped frame 1, so fox-girl's trailer rig only moves (-17, +2) px; raven-girl's rig is refitted to the new frame 1.
rejected: Round 1 #6, #12, #18 and #23 draw a dark ground line under the feet. Round 1 #17 (fox-boy contactB) and #19 (fox-girl down) carry a solid sole shadow that would set the ground row 2 px low; round 2 re-rendered those two poses with an added sentence ("The feet stand on nothing: there is no shadow, no ground line and no dark strip under the boots; below the soles everything is fully transparent."), seeds 28203-28204, and #1 / #3 replace them.
measured: On the built webp. head_track.py --ref 1: head bob raven-girl 2.3 %, raven-boy 1.9 %, fox-boy 1.6 %, fox-girl 1.3 % (shipped 6.8 / 5.9 / 5.6 / 5.1 %), head x drift <= 2 px, head scale 1.00 on every frame. walk_audit.py: centre drift 0.7 / 0.7 / 1.1 / 1.4 px (shipped 3.8 / 3.1 / 10.5 / 10.4 px), ground row within 1 px.

frames.tool: ComfyUI qwen21_edit (Qwen Image 2.1 int8 single-image edit), 25 steps euler/simple, cfg 1, 1024 px budget
frames.label: raven-boy-down
frames.prompt: This is an RGBA format image with transparency. Edit <image1>, a little raven boy walking to the right. Change only its legs and feet, so that both feet are flat on the ground under the body: the front leg (on the right) is bent at the knee and takes the weight, and the back foot (on the left) is a short step behind with its heel just lifting. Both legs look exactly like the legs in <image1>: the same golden-orange colour, the same scaly texture with soft shading, dark brown outlines and small dark claws. Both legs are the same colour. Keep the head, the big yellow eye, the beak, the spiky dark blue feathers on the head, the yellow pencil behind the head, the grey hooded jacket, the brown satchel and strap, the brown book with gold corners held in both hands, and the tail feathers exactly as they are, in the same place, the same size. The raven still faces right. The lowest foot stands on the same ground line as in <image1>. Change nothing else. Same painted style, same dark outlines. No ground, no shadow, no motion lines, no text. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.
frames.then: tools/art-local/deshadow.py --like raven-boy-f1-x3.png; CPU swing (tail feathers lift), tools/art-local/swing_part.py --cut x:330 --angle -7 --box 40,820,330,1010 --ramp 80
